description:
Store each gate run at `gate-runs/<issue-id>/<run-id>.json`, so an issue's run history is one directory and no reader enumerates other issues' runs.

## Background

`VirtualPath::gate_run_record(&IssueId, &GateRunId)` (`crates/jit/src/repository_state/path.rs`) is the only builder of a run record path and still produces the flat `gate-runs/<run-id>/result.json`; its issue argument is unused. Its own test pins that path (`repository_state/mutation.rs:1400-1410` today). Both backends list an issue's runs through one shared reader that enumerates the whole `gate-runs/` root and filters by `issue_id`. The storage reference renders the path from the constructor (`storage/reference.rs:462,797`), and `test_committed_reference_matches_projection` (`:817`) requires `docs/reference/storage-records.md` to match the projection. Every test fixture builds run paths through the constructor. Kept as one change for a golden-test reason: the committed reference renders the path from the constructor, so it is regenerated in the same commit; its prose is revised separately.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `VirtualPath::gate_run_record` names `gate-runs/<issue-id>/<run-id>.json`; its own test pins that path, and `gate-run-flat-path-bridge` no longer exists.
- [hard] REQ-02: The shared reader lists one issue's runs by reading `gate-runs/<issue-id>/` only and parses only its records. The conformance case shows that a corrupt record of another issue fails no lookup and applies its clutter rules inside the issue's directory.
- [hard] REQ-03: The committed storage-record reference is regenerated by its script and matches the projection.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the semantic-types epic (2195c98f): issue ids are `IssueId`, gate-run ids `GateRunId`, gate keys `GateKey`, lease ids `LeaseId`, events are an `Event` envelope around a tagged `EventBody`, and record paths come from `VirtualPath` constructors. Line citations name current code, which that epic retypes.
- The regenerated reference is mechanical output; its prose is revised separately.
- Manual gate attestations already publish gate-run records carrying their attestor, time and status, and gate status reads them from those records. The relayout moves attestation records with every other run and keeps that behaviour: the latest-run and history views still show each attestation.
title: Gate-run records live under their issue
